title: Reuse SSTable index cache
constraints: Preserve SSTable lookup and iterator semantics
rationale: SsTable already builds cached index_keys and index_offsets when opening a table. find_ge, read_block, and new_iterator rebuilt or collected equivalent index data during hot lookup and scan paths, adding allocation and cloning overhead.
steps: Use cached index_keys to locate the start block for find_ge
Use cached index_offsets for block length calculations
Share cached index_offsets with SsTableIterator instead of cloning a new Vec
expected_impact: Reduces repeated allocation and cloning in SSTable point lookup, range lookup, and iterator initialization paths.
